description: This file defines the internal class GrainReferenceRuntime which implements the IGrainReferenceRuntime interface. It manages grain references, invoking methods asynchronously, applying filters, and handling cancellation tokens within the Orleans distributed framework.

classes.name: GrainReferenceRuntime
classes.description: An internal class responsible for managing grain references, invoking methods with optional filtering and handling cancellation tokens in the Orleans runtime environment.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync<TResult>
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a grain method with a specified reference, request, and options, possibly applying filters.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync
methods.description: Overload that invokes a grain method asynchronously without a specific result type.

methods.name: InvokeMethod
methods.description: Invokes a grain method synchronously, primarily for one-way calls.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Casts a generic addressable grain to a specific interface type, creating a reference if necessary.

methods.name: SetGrainCancellationTokensTarget
methods.description: Associates grain cancellation tokens with the target grain reference.
